title: Delete herdr's pi agent kind and its `pi --list-models` catalog reads
description:
After 2q5, no embedded profile routes herdr to kind pi, but runconfig still compiles a herdr spawn of the pi CLI for kind pi (kinds.go pi row, interrupt.go 'pi' key), and the herdr spawn and the runconfig catalog both shell out to `pi --list-models`. This is the last pi-CLI worker path in the tree. Kind 'pi' is shared with the durable routing in .tick/runners.toml, so this needs a design choice (refuse kind pi on the herdr executor, or rename the durable kind) rather than a blind delete.
